summary: Solana Co filed an 8-K reporting a registered direct offering of 3,076,922 shares of Class A common stock at $2.60 per share, raising approximately $7.9 million in net proceeds. The offering was made under securities purchase agreements with purchasers, relying on exemptions under Section 4(a)(2) and Rule 506 for unregistered put options. Proceeds will be used for accumulating SOL, working capital, and general corporate purposes. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
